notes: Implementation is clean and well-scoped. Regexes have correct boundary guards with '.' exclusion in lookbehind. The min-length filter (_MIN_SYMBOL_LENGTH=6) effectively removes noise. EC2 note: URL path segments that happen to be valid camelCase ARE extracted — this is an acceptable trade-off since adding '/' to the lookbehind would break extraction from stack traces and code paths in JIRA tickets.
